title: The Little Fixes
summary: The straw that stays put: a bendy straw and bottle-cap idea using INTENSE Lowfat Strawberry Milk purchased at Wegmans, with real family photographs and safety notes.
search: An AUsome Life The Little Fixes. Small practical everyday family tips and kitchen-counter tricks. A bendy straw through a small opening in the screw cap of INTENSE strawberry milk from Wegmans. Straw stays upright. Adult cuts small slit with cap removed, checks for sharp edges and loose plastic. Not leakproof or spillproof. Keep milk refrigerated. Upstate Farms Intense Milk. Simple household workaround.
